visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a split-screen view. On the bottom half, a mobile MOBA character in ornate green and gold armor stands heroically against a fantasy background. On the top right, a young man with dark hair and black-rimmed glasses, wearing a light purple shirt, looks at his screen with a confused facial expression. A black banner at the bottom displays white and colored social media handles for 'Gary'. (2) The scene transitions to actual mobile gameplay footage showing a overhead view of a tactical map. The camera follows stylized characters moving across lanes with detailed greenery and stone structures. Various colorful skill effects explode as characters clash, while the man's reaction window shrinks but remains in the frame as he observes the chaotic movement. (3) The gameplay intensifies with rapid character movements and numerous status bars appearing above figures. The man picks up a white megaphone and shouts into it, his face showing extreme animation and high energy. Sudden variety-show style text overlays in bright colors pop up periodically to emphasize his loud vocal outbursts during the chaotic combat climax. (4) The screen shifts to a darker, more relaxed color palette at the end. The man is shown leaning back in his chair with a neutral, slightly defeated look, as if exhausted by the previous intense gaming events. Text appears explaining the final outcome of the match, while social media icons remain visible at the bottom of the frame.
